P3.2.text: Innovative Optimized PTFE filmcast liner technology (O-PTFE) delivers superior durability, lubricity, and flexibility for neurovascular embolization,

P3.3.text: OPTIMIZED PTFE FILMCAST LINER TECHNOLOGY (O-PTFE) Flexibility Meets Durability.

P3.4.text: Our innovative O-PTFE Liner technology (O-PTFE) delivers high-performance solutions for neurovascular embolization, aspiration, and micro catheters. This technology combines the flexibility of filmcast with the durability and robustness of RAM extruded PTFE, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of medical applications.

P3.6.text: High-pressure resistance: Accommodates the delivery of embolization agents

P3.7.text: Ultra-thin walls: Maximizes flow rates and facilitates device interface

P3.8.text: Let's Start an O-PTFE Project Together

P3.9.text: Advanced Liner Technology for Complex Neuro and Peripheral Vascular Catheter Applications

P3.10.text: Integer's O-PTFE liner technology is designed to address the specific needs for complex procedures. By integrating the flexibility of filmcast with the strength of RAM extruded PTFE, this technology ensures that medical devices can navigate intricate anatomical pathways with ease.

P3.11.text: Balancing Flexibility with Durability for Optimal Performance

P3.12.text: Our O-PTFE offers a unique combination of flexibility and durability, making it an ideal choice for various applications.

P3.13.text: The attached tip, O-PTFE filmcast liner, coil, shield, outer jacket, and heat-shrink components work together to enhance the overall performance of the device. This advanced material technology ensures that the liner maintains its mechanical properties, providing both strength and adaptability. The innovative design allows for better maneuverability and reliability, making it suitable for a wide range of uses.

P3.14.text: By integrating these features, the O-PTFE liner sets a new standard in material science and engineering design.

P3.15.text: The durability and lubricity of the O-PTFE liner are critical for ensuring smooth and efficient performance in medical devices. These properties help minimize delivery forces while maintaining flexibility, which is essential for navigating complex anatomical pathways.

P3.16.text: The enhanced durability of the O-PTFE liner means that it can withstand the rigors of repeated use without degrading in quality, providing reliability and consistency. The lubricity of the liner ensures that it can move smoothly within the body, reducing friction and making procedures less invasive.

P3.19.text: Durability and Lubricity comparable to extruded PTFE

P1.2.text: UFP Technologies is the trusted design, development, engineering, and manufacturing partner to turn your vision into a reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions primarily for medical devices and sterile packaging, as well as other highly engineered custom products.

P1.3.text: MedTech evolves at breathtaking speeds. To keep pace, you need forward-thinking collaboration to develop your idea and anticipate the challenges at each phase of the process. UFP MedTech is the ideal partner to help you accelerate single-use and single patient devices from development through launch and manufacturing.

P1.4.text: For aerospace, defense, automotive, and other highly engineered components and packaging, our advanced engineering capabilities and materials expertise ensures optimal designs and seamless implementation to make your vision a reality.

P1.6.text: Trust UFP Technologies to turn your vision into reality with best-in-class comprehensive solutions based on our vast depth of engineering expertise. Our nimble and dynamic team will work with you to create custom designs from foams, films, plastics, nonwovens, fabrics, and other specialty materials. All with the ultimate goal of positioning your ideas for success.

P1.7.text: From the initial stages of development, we review your project from every angle, assigning a dedicated team to fully understand the unique needs and potential challenges before we start.

P1.8.text: We act as an extension of your R&D and engineering teams, applying our vast materials expertise and design skills, so that each decision we make is optimized for the application.

P1.9.text: We understand the importance of delivering sound engineering and rapid prototypes. Our in-house tooling capabilities and custom equipment allow us to execute quickly and accurately, producing prototypes within 72 hours.

P1.10.text: Mitigating any potential risks through quality management systems ensures a seamless transition from prototype to full-scale production.

P1.11.text: Our turnkey solutions include high volume manufacturing, packaging, and supply chain management through multiple global locations to get your product to market quickly and efficiently.

Our single-use and single-patient devices and components are used in a wide range of medical devices and packaging for minimally invasive surgery, infection prevention, wound care, wearables, orthopedic soft goods, and orthopedic implants.
